title: Chapter 1: Return to Phlan
body:
The final game in the series follows Pool of Radiance. Ten years after defeating Bane, the party sails back to Phlan, now a thriving city.
Harbormaster Rolf welcomes you. Explore the city, then visit Sasha, now a council member. She asks you to escort her to inspect troops in Thar. Buy supplies and meet her at Kuto's Gate.
After passing Kuto's Well and Podal Plaza, you reach a hill. Clouds gather over the Moonsea, a storm breaks, and Bane appears. He announces that the great coastal cities have fallen and that Kalistes, Tanetal and Gothmenes will rule them. Darkness covers the sun and storms keep outsiders away. When he is ready, he will overrun the Realms.
A gate draws the party into a weightless space. There Elminster explains that Limbo connects the planes and that Bane also uses it to move his armies. If Elminster leaves or dies, Bane will control Limbo and the Moonsea. Elminster sends you back to begin the adventure.
- Before Bane attacks, Phlan has no monsters; any inn is suitable for resting.
- The council offers no jobs at first. Return after Marcus' Tower.
- After returning from Marcus' Tower, defeat the enemies besieging Phlan before its gates reopen.
- Sasha gives the party three spell scrolls when you accept her mission.

title: Chapter 2: Limbo and the Moonsea
body:
Chapter 2: Limbo and the Moonsea settlements
Elminster maintains Limbo as a safe staging area between the planes. You can rest, receive healing and leave equipment here; he keeps the monsters away. Magical items from the Realms cannot be taken to the other planes, and magical weapons from those planes are destroyed if brought back to the Realms. Leave all magical equipment in Limbo before departing. Store spare money and weapons here to reduce your load.
Cities that resisted Bane have fallen, and monsters roam the Moonsea. Dragons and giants gather in the Dragonspine Mountains. The drow have summoned many mages, while Mulmaster houses Bane's followers and forces. A few surviving outposts offer places to camp.
The following maps cover these small settlements. Their numbered locations follow the magazine's keys.
- The cluster of cottages is safe for camping. Enemies interrupt rest in the small castle and large farmhouse. The wayhouse offers rest and information.
- Learn about the hill giant steading by rescuing the woman at small castle 7 or giving water to the dying warrior at farm buildings 2.
- Cottage settlement: Bane's troops drove out the inhabitants. A remaining woodcutter tells you about Myth Drannor and Marcus' Tower.
- Small village: beholders threaten the residents. Kill them to claim their treasure.
- Small stockade: formerly under Phlan's authority, it is now besieged by dragons. See location 3 below.
- Crossroads: cloud giants occupy the cross-shaped building. Rescue four captives and take the giants' treasure.

title: Chapter 3: Sasha and Thar
body:
Taydome's ancient keep stands in Thar. A thousand years ago he helped giants and ogres defeat gold dragons. In gratitude they gave him a powerful scroll, said to control giants and ogres. Sasha plans to inspect troops and find out what Kimarr and Quil discovered while investigating the keep.
Kimarr has turned to evil and uses the scroll to control the giants and ogres. Quil remains loyal to Phlan and has hidden the scroll deep inside. Kimarr captures Sasha as she enters. Quil frees her but cannot get her out.
Inside, someone claiming to be Sasha's guard approaches you. He is Kimarr in disguise, hoping you will lead him to Quil so he can kill you both. Quil secretly leaves important messages. Once rescued, Sasha can use the keep as a temporary base.
- Giants and ogres initially let you move freely.
- Quil's journal messages appear at several locations marked 3.
- Letting the disguised guard join provides more information; refusing him makes camping safer.
- With the guard in your party, entering the treasury causes injury. He reveals himself at 12 and complains that you failed to find Quil.
- Kimarr becomes a dragon at 18. Defeat him to break the scroll's magic.

title: Chapter 4: Vala against Vaasa
body:
To please Bane, Vaasa plans to use Earth Elementals and Fire Elementals to tunnel through the mountains. Its armies could then reach the Moonsea without crossing the frozen wastes. Vala of the Silver Blades has gathered rather dim Hill Giants to oppose Vaasa.
Four items control the elementals: the Oakroot Staff, World Stone, Crucible of Flame and Lindenwood Staff. Join Vala and recover them. Ancient ghosts, monsters and giants also inhabit the caves.
- Without Vala, Hill Giants attack at 5 and 6.
- Find every item: World Stone at 4, Lindenwood Staff at 8, Oakroot Staff at 13, Crucible of Flame at 18. All are needed to drive off the elementals and Vaasa's forces.
- Refuse Vala at 3 and the Hill Giants mistake you for Vaasan soldiers.
- Camping is safe at 3.

title: Chapter 5: Temple of Tyr
body:
Priam leads Hillsfar's forces in Yulash and is mayor of Verdigris. He brought soldiers to the Temple of Tyr to equip them from its armory. After darkness fell, the city was looted and evil forces seized the armory. He asks you to recover it.
Brimwuff's spirit still guards the armory, honoring the oath Tyr gave him in life. Pass his tests to obtain the weapons. You also meet his beloved Laurellin and may reunite the pair after centuries apart.
Random patrols continue until you kill the Vampire Priest at 3. Rest safely at 5; elsewhere becomes safe only after lighting the four braziers and ringing the bell.
- Light the 4 braziers with the Lamp of Vigilance from 17.
- Obtain the lamp first. Pulling the bell rope must be the final action.
- Taking anything at 9 brings the Curse of Tyr.
- Journal entry 11 explains the rituals at 14.

title: Chapter 6: Hill giant steading
body:
Bane gathers mercenaries in this fortress controlling passage through the Dragonspine Mountains. A Hill Giant Shaman rules it. Mercenaries fight in the streets to impress him.
At the Twisted Horn tavern, Sasha's agent Rardal advises killing some Cloud Giants to gain an audience. Later the agent, spelled Kardal in the magazine's later text, is captured. Rescuing him triggers an alarm, forcing you to fight your way to the shaman.
- Take a room at 3 as a resting base.
- At 16, choose Challenge their authority to make enemies fight each other.
- At 5, choose Duck before either side wins; then fight only the survivors.
- The shopkeeper at 23 steals money if you neither buy nor sell.

title: Chapter 7: Fire giant caves
body:
An ambitious Fire Giant Mage disputes territory with both the Hill Giant Shaman and Thorne. She has enchanted the passages to trap intruders. Mistaking the party for equally ambitious rivals, she goes to great lengths to stop you and ultimately causes her own downfall.

title: Chapter 8: Dragon aerie
body:
The evil mage Modthryth controls this gathering place for Thorne's dragons. White, Black, Blue and Green Dragons respectively guard silver, iron, steel and copper keys. All four are required for the portal to Thorne's cave.
Find the Steel Key at Blue Dragon lair 4, copper key at Green Dragon lair 5, Silver Key at White Dragon lair 6, and Iron Key at Black Dragon lair 7.
- Defeat Green Dragons to pass entrance 1.
- The dimensional gate at 16 requires keys from 4,5,6,7.
- Burning dragon corpses at 14 gives experience, but the smoke attracts dragons.
- Camp safely at 9.
- Use Search to find the treasure at 8.

title: Chapter 9: Thorne's cave
body:
Heed Elminster: train, prepare the party and leave equipment in Limbo before entering the portal. Kill Thorne before he blows the Horn of Doom a third time. The first blast notifies Bane, the second readies the dragons, and the third releases them against the Realms and destroys the cities temporarily held in Limbo.
The horn was made from a Ki-rin's horn; its spirit still wanders here. Raizel, a thief who knows the caves, can help locate Thorne, but repeatedly urges you to seek treasure first. Ignore those diversions until Thorne is dead.
Taking the Horn of Doom ends the Moonsea storms. Reinforcements then leave Tilverton overland through the Dragonspine Mountains and sail from Tantras, journal entry 47.
- Give the equipment beside the Ki-rin at 2 to front-rank fighters first. The Red Dragons' spoils at 4 mainly suit unarmed mages and clerics.
- Raizel demands a share of the treasure. Taking her gives more experience, but her treasure hunts waste time.
- Leave treasure at 6 until Thorne is dead. It is only money, adding weight and giving dragons time to gather.
- Detouring for Raizel gives Red Dragons time to assemble at 11.
- The Ki-rin's spirit makes 14 safe for camping.
- Defeat Thorne at 16 for the Horn of Doom, journal entry 34, one of the items required for Dark Phlan.

title: Chapter 10: Zhentil Keep
body:
On Bane's orders, drow entered Zhentil Keep through secret cave passages and occupied it. They seize residents for Manshoon's Tower and the slave camp.
At the tavern, Mabril tells you about Kalistes and Traned and points out a secret way into Manshoon's Tower, avoiding the guards' extortion. During a drow roundup, you see an old man forced onto a wagon while his daughter pleads. Different responses can yield useful information.
- Pay, Bluff or Grovel to pass the front gate; the latter choices are less dignified.
- Attacking at the gate sounds an alarm and brings increasing numbers of drow.
- Nothing happens at 15 if the Temple of Tyr quest is already finished.

title: Chapter 11: Manshoon's Tower
body:
Two routes lead from Zhentil Keep into the tower. The front brings inspections, extortion and attacks. The secret entrance avoids needless fights but is one-way. Inside, climb to confront Manshoon's magic or descend to the drow dungeon.
An invisible creature on the third floor uses a gaze attack. A Mirror or silver shield can counter it. At the top, break Manshoon's spells. His own summoned creatures then demolish the floor while he escapes.
- The front route passes checkpoint 3, Liches at 4 and guards at 5.
- Secret passage 2 bypasses them but cannot be used to leave.
- Attack the Zhentil Guards at 13 immediately.

title: Chapter 11: Manshoon, continued
body:
Chapter 11 continued: Manshoon's Tower
This continues the previous issue's floor plans with locations 14 through 23: two difficult battles, a gaze attack and the breaking of Manshoon's spells.
Locations 14,15 form one route. At 14, dragons wait in ambush. Use 15 to circle behind and strike first. At 16, a Beholder leads Fire Giants, Ettins and Salamanders: difficult opponents with worthwhile rewards. Gelt's gaze at 17 needs a prepared countermeasure.
Taking the Necklace of Missiles in basement 18 draws you into Manshoon's magical walls. His own summoned hag frees you. At 19 and 20, destroying his spellbook breaks his spells; his summoned creatures then wreck the tower, so escape quickly. At 22 is a mixed Zhentil and drow force; 23 exits to the drow dungeon.
- Treasure at 16 includes Magical Darts, Magical Bolts and a Ring of Cold Resistance.
- Counter the gaze at 17 with Traned's Silver Shield if she is present, or Power Word Blind.
- Be ready for the magical-wall event before taking the necklace at 18.
- At 19,20, choose Shoot against the spellbook. The magic vanishes and you must escape the collapsing tower.
- Treasure at 22: Elfin Chain +2, Dagger +4, Trident +4, Light Crossbow +4, Darts +4 and a Clerical Scroll.

body:
Map: Tower locations 14-23; plans in issue 43

title: Chapter 12: Drow dungeon
body:
Beneath Manshoon's Tower lies the drow base. Rather than face you openly, they strike and retreat to wear you down. Clear one area at a time instead of chasing them.
Recruit Traned, described here as a half-elf, to reduce searching and needless fights. At the Winnowing Room, let her escort slaves out before you advance to free the remaining captives in the slave camp.
Drow often harass the party after resting near 5. Small rooms, used only once each, are more reliable rest spots.
- Search 6 to meet Traned, journal entry 97.
- Look before entering camp 8 to spot the ambush.
- A narrow gap in door 12 lets only Traned through; enemies at 13 capture her. Open it fully for the whole party instead.
- Circle behind the archers at 14.
- Stairs 15 are one-way; return by the stairs at the corridor's far end.
- At Winnowing Room 16, imitating the drow's steps injures Traned. Afterward she can lead the slaves away, journal entry 77.
- Magical guards at 17,18 throw people into an abyss, choosing Traned first if present.

title: Chapter 13: Drow slave camp
body:
Silk seeks her fellow Swanmays. Help her obtain the Essence of Pure Light and destroy the Fire of Night, where spiders become Pets of Kalistes.
Follow arrows on the floor to Silk. Promise to rescue her companions and she joins, journal entry 73. Defeat the drow captain, take the cell keys and free the Swanmays and Zhentil citizens. Silk explains the three temple traps and gives weapons and an amulet, usable at guard post 19, journal entry 89.
Find the essence, traverse the traps and destroy the Fire of Night. The sketch from 22, journal entry 5, guides you through the traps. Take the Medallion from the chest at 21 to make the Iron Golem stand aside.
- Attack immediately at 9 to save the woman whose soul the drow alchemist is extracting. She explains how to destroy the Fire of Night.
- Essence jars at 10 supply what Lil says to use at 17.
- Attack the ritual at 12 now, or face its participants again at 17. Its spiders become large Pets of Kalistes.
- Follow the sketch from 22 along its dotted line through the paired arches at 13.
- Close your eyes at 14 as Silk instructs.
- Follow journal entry 5 through the teleports at 15.
- Use Silk's amulet at 19 if you helped her.

18. Secret door to Kalistes' Temple.
19. Use Silk's amulet if you helped her.
21. Chest holding the Medallion used at 16.
22. Priestess's quarters. Search for the sketch covering traps 13 to 15.
23. Spiders awaiting transformation.
25. Newly transformed Pets of Kalistes.

title: Chapter 14: Kalistes' Temple
body:
The temple is Kalistes' gateway into the material world. Its portal from the Web lets her spiders keep entering the Moonsea. The front route from the drow dungeon is harder than the slave camp's secret passage. You meet Traned again, also seeking slaves to rescue.
Close the monster gates, then travel through Limbo to the Web. Ultimately defeat Kalistes and her army for the Crystal Ring.
Enemies include Giant, Enormous, Phase, Gaze, Stone and Electric Spiders. Pets of Kalistes and Driders are especially dangerous. Most spiders poison; Enormous Spiders pose a particular risk.
- Observe at 1 for information and pose as messengers to pass the magical barrier.
- The barrier at 2 hurts you and sends you to cell 11.
- Have a thief steal the antidote from the table at 6 and treat the slaves at 8, or the guards at 8 keep returning.
- Escape cell 11 by picking the lock, receiving Traned's help, or being mistaken for Marcus' messengers.
- At ceremony 15, destroy the statue's hands as journal entry 93 instructs. Other planar gates vanish, stopping the invasion. The remaining gate leads to Limbo.
- Drow equipment can pass safely through the portal.

title: Map: Kalistes' Temple
body:
1. Observe the short entrance passage for information. Messenger disguises pass the barrier safely.
2. Main entrance barrier injures you and sends you to cell 11.
3. Secret entrance used to bring in spiders for transformation. Safer, though spiders and pets may still appear.
5. Drow awaiting tests; defeat them for a Battle Axe +4.
6. Two drow talk, journal entry 42. A thief can steal the antidote on their table for the slaves at 8.
7. Save a slave from a drow and meet Traned again.
8. Treat captives with the antidote from 6 or guards keep returning.
9. Priests select and poison slaves; rescue them.
10. More captives guarded by pets.
11. Prison reached by barrier 2; entering voluntarily also traps you. Pick the lock, accept Traned's help or pose as Marcus' messengers.
12. Priest headquarters. Two priests discuss deployment and leave a map marking three places.
13. An evil priest warns the drow, journal entry 93.
14. Two drow bribe a priest for ceremony seats. Pose as Marcus' messengers to learn its purpose.
15. Fight at the ceremony, then destroy the statue's hands, journal entry 93. Other gates vanish; the last leads through Limbo to the Web.

title: Chapter 15: The Web
body:
Chapter 15: The Web and its spider-shaped buildings
Reach the barren Web through Limbo. Comparable in size to the Moonsea region, it contains villages, temples and ruins. Find and kill Kalistes. The overview marks the spider-shaped building, stockade, parlor, roadside village, ruined city, forest village, lava fortress, ruined temple and Testing Ground.
People you meet may ask to join. Their motives affect entry to the Testing Ground and parlor.
PEOPLE
- Cynthia: a former Swanmay sought by Silk, now cursed as an Eye of Kalistes. You meet her on arrival; she explains what is needed to enter the parlor.
- Storm Harngrim: an escaped dwarf searching for his sister Arta.
- Dennia: mother of Hern, a young drow candidate. Her brother Daris wants Hern dead. Promise to save him and she leads you through a secret entrance to the Testing Ground.
- Valardis: hired by Daris to kill Hern; he leads you to the priests.
- Angry slave: Tanetal's spy, offering entry to the parlor.
- Locaste: a senior drow priestess seen entering the parlor.
GENERAL ADVICE
- Enemies are strong but treasure and experience are generous. Save often.
- Gather equipment, allies and experience before facing Kalistes.
- Do not offend Cynthia, or Kalistes' minions attack more often.
- Dennia offers the simplest Testing Ground entry. Without a Ward of Safe Passage, find the angry slave for entry to the parlor.
- Seven buildings share a floor plan but have different numbered features. Consult each key: A ruined temple; B stockade; C lava fortress; D forest village; E ruined city; F roadside village; G spider-shaped building.

title: Map A: Ruined temple
body:
1. Drow guards can take you to Cynthia at 4.
3. Spiders drag away a Long Sword +4.
4. Portal between the Web and Limbo. The Eye of Kalistes asks who helped you at the temple. Answer Silk; she is glad her fellow Swanmay lives. She gives journal entry 44 and three tasks: bring a spider from 5, capture a drow from 1, then kill her. Refuse and Kalistes learns your whereabouts immediately.
5. Firefly cave. Catch a spider and return it to Cynthia at 4.

title: Map B: Stockade
body: 1. Dig for a Trident +3.\n2. Guard post with Scale Mail +4.\n5. Storm the dwarf wants to rescue his sister Arta from the parlor.

title: Map C: Lava fortress
body:
1. Defeat spiders for a Light Crossbow and Composite Long Bow, both +3, and arrows and bolts, 10 of each.
3. Without Valardis, resting brings a thief who steals from you and runs southeast.
4. Without Valardis, find Dennia fighting spiders, with your stolen belongings at her waist. Recruiting her helps entry to the Testing Ground; leaving this place then takes you straight there.
5. Search carefully for Scale Mail +4.

title: Map D: Forest village
body: 1. If Dennia is absent, meet Valardis, hired to kill her son Hern. He asks to join. He eases Testing Ground entry but brings trouble; leaving the village with him goes straight there.\n2. Open a cocoon for a Scimitar +4.\n3. Searching draws spiders; defeat them for equipment left by earlier adventurers.

title: Map E: Ruined city
body: 1. A disguise avoids combat.\n3. Open a door and defeat the spiders for Elfin Chain +4.\n4. Open the long cocoon for two Javelins +4.

title: Map F: Roadside village
body: 1. Locaste tries to enter the parlor through the webs. Without a Ward of Safe Passage, green spiders devour her. With the ward, the party enters safely; without it, you are confined in storage.\n5. A drow child steals your purse. Reprimand and release the child; throwing the child into the webs causes a hard spider battle.

title: Map G: Spider-shaped building
body:
1. An angry slave offers a secret route into the parlor. Taking him gives entry but he later betrays you. Leaving the building with him takes you straight there.
3. Follow spiders struggling over an object to find Banded Mail +4.
4. The slave diverts a drow patrol if present, avoiding combat.
5. The slave vouches for you to drow guards, giving you a chance to kill some first.

title: Chapter 16: Testing Ground
body:
Young drow seeking priestly or magical rank face tests here; failure makes them Driders. Pass seven tests and defeat high priest Shest for the Wand of Safe Passage and an amulet. The wand permits entry to Kalistes' Parlor. The amulet repels large spiders and can help Dennia save Hern.
Drow ranks and spider types vary. The final fight includes Enormous Spiders and Pets of Kalistes. Rest at the drow camp or after each completed test.
- Strength, 9: have the strongest character, at least 15 Strength, push the wall; Strength or Enlarge can help.
- Courage, 10: walk straight ahead.
- Combat, 11: defeat Driders.
- Magic, 12: high-level drow mages. Cast Prayer and other protection first.
- Wisdom, 13: the riddle answer is Bane.
- Seeing through illusion, 14: walk through the illusory fire wall, which still hurts you.
- Temptation, 15: Hern appears with a scepter. Approach with any character; he reveals himself as a Drider and others surround you. Defeat him to finish the tests.

body:
1. Main entrance with drow guards.
2. Priests' and mages' secret passage, used by Valardis.
3. Dennia's secret entrance to rescue Hern.
4. Free captive Driders for information.
5. Powerful mage Daris. Dennia explains the dagger and amulet, journal entry 92.
6. Mage Balia and the mirror, journal entry 28. Touching the basin or scepter sounds an alarm.
7. Powerful mage Locaste seeks the Wand of Safe Passage to report your arrival to Kalistes; eavesdrop for journal entry 55.
8. Once inside by a secret door, finish all tests before leaving.
9. Strength test.
10. Courage test.
11. Combat test.
12. Magic test.
13. Wisdom test; answer Bane.

15. Temptation test.

17. At the altar, intervene in the spell on Hern. Daris flees with the wand to 18; pursue him.
18. Fight Daris' followers. Daris becomes a Drider, journal entry 52. High priest Shest also contests the Wand of Safe Passage.
19. Clear the drow camp to rest safely.

title: Chapter 17: Kalistes' Parlor
body:
The two-level parlor is Kalistes' lair. Kill her and her spiders for the Crystal Ring. Upstairs holds living quarters, kitchen, dining room, study, servants' rooms and armory. Below are slave cells, pet rooms, torture chamber and nursery. Three routes connect the floors; the kitchen's secret route is safest.
- Gate 1 requires the Testing Ground's Wand of Safe Passage. Corner passages descend but are poor routes; spiders also climb through them.
- Rescue Arta from imminent death in kitchen 3. She tells her story and warns about the secret passage below.
- Armory 5 brings Driders and spiders on every visit. After clearing them, find a locked descent in the corner.
- At 6, the angry slave gives another Mirror of Kalistes, says the lower door's key is at 10, and favors the kitchen passage.
- Food at 9 is deadly poison.
- Slaves at 11 are Kalistes' dinner. Lacking the passage item and not having met the angry slave causes injury.
- Destroy eggs at 17 to draw Kalistes out. After taking her Crystal Ring, the slave reveals himself as Tanetal's spy, demands the ring and summons Earth Elementals. Win this battle to leave.

title: Map: Kalistes' Parlor, upper
body:
Map: Kalistes' Parlor, upper floor
1. Main gate requires the Wand of Safe Passage. Secret corner passages lead down and also admit spiders.
2. Entry point when led by the angry slave.
3. Kitchen. Save the dwarf girl Arta before she is killed for her story and warning about the secret descent.
4. Drow servants provoke you until a fight begins.
5. Armory. Driders and spiders appear every visit. Clear them for the locked descent in the corner.
6. The angry slave gives another Mirror of Kalistes, identifies key location 10 and recommends the kitchen passage.
7. War room. A strategy book discusses marilith weaknesses.
8. Room containing several spell scrolls.
9. Dining room; the appetizing food is lethally poisoned.
10. Scrying room with the lower passage's key.
19. Abandoned teleport station.
20. Drow guardroom.
21. Drow waiting area.

title: Map: Kalistes' Parlor, lower
body:
Map: Kalistes' Parlor, lower floor
11. Slave cells holding Kalistes' intended dinner. Lacking the passage item or not having met the angry slave causes injury.
12. Female slaves and prisoners.
13. Male slaves and prisoners.
14. Heavily guarded treasury, accessible once the lower door opens.
15. Dangerous pet-spider base reached by the kitchen chute.
16. Nursery with successive monster battles.
17. Destroy the eggs to draw Kalistes out and defeat her for the Crystal Ring. The angry slave then demands the ring, reveals his spying and summons Earth Elementals. Defeat them to leave.
18. Torture chamber.

title: Chapter 18: Myth Drannor
body:
Chapter 18: Nacacia and Myth Drannor
Nacacia, princess of Cormyr and leader of Myth Drannor's knightly alliance, is overwhelmed by rumors that Rakshasas joined Bane and Tyranthraxus returned. She asks you to investigate the frightened city.
Walking Trees and Rakshasas roam here. Only magic hurts Rakshasas: weapons +1 and +2 cause half damage. Higher Rakshasas ignore weapons +1 and take half damage from +2 and +3. The magazine recommends missiles such as Blessed Bolts. Bring a Mirror or silver shield for the Medusa and Basilisk ambush at 8.
- If you promised help, Nacacia gives Elfin Chain +4, Arrows +4, Fine Long Bow +2, Light Crossbow +3 and Bolts +4 at gate 1.
- Detect Magic reveals the false elf at 7 and false knight at 14.
- Spectres attack on entering 11. Lay the elven skeletons to rest for experience, or take their Girdle of Giant Strength, Blessed Bolts, Bolts +5 and Light Crossbow +2.
- The murdered knights at 12 overwhelm Nacacia. Comfort her to keep her with you, then help her up to restore her confidence.
- At blocked gate 15, a nimble character can climb and lower a rope; the girdle from 11 can force it open.
- Free the knights' spirits at 16 with Dispel Evil or by destroying the orb.
- Camp safely at 17.

title: Map: Nacacia and Myth Drannor
body:
1. Front gate. If you offered help, receive Elfin Chain +4, Arrows +4, Fine Long Bow +2, Light Crossbow +3 and Bolts +4.
2. A Rakshasa beside dead knights holds a blue-glowing orb.
3. Residents' homes.
4. Rakshasas patrol the streets.
5. Nacacia spots traces of something dragged south.
6. Search for Composite Long Bow +3, Arrows +4, Bolts, Blessed Bolts and Light Crossbow +3.
7. Detect Magic exposes a Rakshasa disguised as an elf.
8. Medusa and Basilisk ambush.
9. Rakshasas drain warriors' life to revive Tyranthraxus.
10. A Banite commands Rakshasas in Bane's name.
11. Spectres attack. Lay elven remains to rest for experience or take the Girdle of Giant Strength, Blessed Bolts, Bolts +5 and Light Crossbow +2.
12. Comfort the shaken Nacacia to keep her with you; help her stand to restore her confidence.
13. Large spiders await prey.
14. Detect Magic reveals a Rakshasa posing as a knight.
15. Climb and lower a rope with high Dexterity, or force the gate with the girdle from 11.
16. A Rakshasa Maharajah seeks to revive Tyranthraxus. Dispel Evil or destroying the orb frees the knights' spirits.
17. Safe campsite.

title: Chapter 19: Marcus' Tower
body:
Bane's general Marcus controls Red Wizards, Black Wizards and Moander cultists, sending monsters into the Realms. Fight upward from the bottom of the Red Tower to discover Phlan beneath it.
Shal explains that her soul was split. Its other half, Petra, serves Marcus. Escort Shal to Petra, kill Marcus and board the Vessel of Moander before the tower collapses to return to Limbo.
LEVELS 0 TO 8
Monsters gather to attack Phlan; many are mages.
- Numbers describe event types and may recur on different floors, including 7,8,12,14. Follow the magazine's key.
- At 8, Listen twice to priests discussing Petra. Leaving early or staying too long reveals you.
- At prison 10, most guards fight and some fetch help. A Flail +4 is here.
- With mages ahead and enemies behind at 16,17, let them fight while you hide in 17. Take the spell scroll and Wand of Ice Storm afterward.
- Shal at 11 has lost her magic. Bring her to the top to stop Marcus.
LEVELS 9,10,11
- Eavesdrop at 5 for password Red; use it at 6 to turn the wizard factions against each other.
- Kill the priests first at 10 to stop the ritual. Black Wizards missed at 9 gather outside.
- At 12, watching the Black Wizards and Bits O Moander lets the wizards escape and return with more guards; immediate attack is the alternative.
- Risk passing the absorbed worshippers in Hall of Change 17. After Marcus dies, Shal or Petra moves the vessel out, causing chaos.
- At room 18, ghosts reveal Marcus only if you first eliminate his allies at 3 or 4,6,10,12 to 15. He fights to the end with waves of monsters. If Shal lives she reunites with Petra; otherwise Petra goes mad. Hurry to the vessel before the tower falls.

title: Map: Tower levels 0-8
body:
Map: Levels 0-8, nine plans with a combined key
1. Walking Trees block routes throughout.
2. Main entrance; spiders descend from above.
3. Side entrance.
4. Communication room. Petra, Shal's other half, warns of Marcus' lethal spells.
5. Small room suitable for camping.
6. Impassable gate where you learn about Phlan and Shal.
7. Enemy troops attack when you try to leave, but only once.
8. Listen twice to priests discussing Petra. Leaving or lingering reveals you.
9. If Shal is in the northern room, hear her calls through cracks in the wall.
10. Most prison guards fight; some fetch reinforcements. Leaving by your entrance meets those reinforcements head-on. Flail +4 here.
11. Shal's cell. Deprived of magic for refusing Bane, she must reach the top to foil Marcus.
12. Moander monsters.
13. Drow spy.
14. More Moander followers.
15. An eerie, windy room causes injury. A dead hero carries Javelin +2, Two-handed Sword +4 and Ring of Protection from Evil.
16,17. Let the forces before and behind you fight, hide in 17, then collect a spell scroll and Wand of Ice Storm.
18,19. Pursue Otyugh guards through the arches and stop them before they report at 19.
20,21. Undead temple where Shal tells her strange story. At 21 find Helmet +4, Ring Mail +4, Shield +4 and Chain Mail +4.

title: Map: Levels 9,10,11
body:
1. A magical gate closes behind you, preventing return.
2. Marcus' war room. Its wall board shows the evil forces' conquests in the Realms.
3. Moander altar with fanatical cultists.
4. Cultists' quarters.
5. Red Wizards' reception room. Eavesdrop for password Red.
6. Use the password to start fighting between Red and Black Wizards.
7,8. Guards tasked with keeping the wizard factions peaceful.
9. Black Wizards' hall.
10. Kill the priests first to interrupt the ritual. Black Wizards left at 9 gather outside.
11. Black Wizards' treasure, including Boots of Speed.
12. Black Wizards and Bits O Moander rest here. Attack immediately or watch; watching lets wizards escape and bring more guards later.
13. Moander cultists.
14. An unavoidable battle with Red Wizards and Bits O Moander.
15. Monsters move slowly in a circle.
16. Join the procession and defeat monsters one at a time, starting at the front.
17. Hall of Change. Risk passing the focused worshippers, possibly attracting guards. After Marcus dies, Shal or Petra tries to move the vessel outside and causes chaos.
18. Marcus' room. Clear his followers at 3 or 4,6,10,12 to 15 first for ghostly directions. Defeat his waves of monsters. Shal and Petra reunite, or Petra goes mad if Shal died. Run for the vessel before collapse.
19. Secret passage to the vessel.
20. Vessel of Moander, a portal to another physical Pool of Darkness. If Shal survives, she gives a Vorpal Long Sword whose bearer can cross between planes.

title: Chapter 20: Moander's body
body:
Chapter 20: Outposts on Moander's body
Moander's immense body has separate areas: the cult temple, wound, ear, mouth, brain, great arm wound, hair, depression leading to Limbo, and heart. Each has its own small map.
Tanetal holds the Talisman of Bane deep in the heart. It is needed to enter Gothmenes' plane. The Watcher, an elf-allied mage monitoring Moander, is initially distant but helps once you earn her trust.
Before entering the heart, help Aeghwaet at the arm wound by removing his enemies. He gives a heartbeat-slowing liquid, explicitly required by the magazine. Rescue a priestess in the hair for another potion, poured into the throat. A slower heartbeat reduces the danger of being swept out of the heart.
A. CULT OF MOANDER
Outsiders at the temple outside the body are imprisoned and made into zombies. Stop the cultists, free captives and collect their property and altar equipment. Agreeing to join at the gate takes you to 13. Cultists stop your first visit to 14. The woman at 15 identifies prison 17 and gives Scimitar +4 and Scale Mail +4. Prisoners freed from 17 seek revenge.
B. HEART ENTRANCE
The wound leads toward the lungs or through muscle directly into the heart. There are three access points; the magazine describes no enemies inside.
C. EAR
A hermit hiding from Tanetal's minions provides equipment and training. Bits of Moander attack along the route.
D. MOUTH
After the hair rescue, pour the priestess's potion into the throat. Trying to force entry through it makes Moander cough you out.
E. BRAIN
Black Wizards monitor Moander's condition and memories with equipment reached through an eye's tear duct. Do not destroy apparatus 5: it explodes.
F. GREAT ARM WOUND
Aeghwaet makes an elixir here, disturbed by Tanetal's excavators. Clear them for the required heart liquid. Red Wizards command Minions of Bane and Earth Elementals; Bits of Moander may appear. He later offers healing and potions of youth and Extra Healing, described as two bottles.
G. HAIR
Save a priestess hunted for sacrifice. She mentions Aeghwaet and her lost potion, used in throat D. One search site is 27; Umber Hulks attack at 28.
H. DEPRESSION
Access to Limbo: portal southwest, entry and exit northwest.
I. HEART
Tanetal studies tissue becoming monsters while holding the talisman. The Watcher is your sole ally. Use the ventricular pressure routes toward atria and arteries, or cross muscle tissue. LUB contracts the ventricle and sweeps you out; DUB expands it and draws you in. These effects apply near the ventricles.
The Watcher appears once each at 11 through 15. An elf detects her presence, especially useful while carrying the heavy Cornucopia, which slows everyone. Deliver it quickly.
The broad sequence is: witness Tanetal kill two helpless soldiers; rescue the Watcher; get a map from a dying soldier; find weapon-sharpening tools; recover her Unguent; obtain the Cornucopia when told and help her put Moander back to sleep; then magnetize weapons and use her trap to expose Tanetal.
- Obtain Aeghwaet's liquid before entering.
- Take the Cornucopia only when told, then deliver it promptly.
- Carry the Magic Mouth from 9 for LUB and DUB warnings.
- Old wound 7 yields two weapons +3 on each of four visits, but disturbing it wakes Moander and speeds the heartbeat.
- The Watcher's Turning Fork stops false Tanetals harassing you.
- Touch wall tissue with magnetized weapons before Tanetal notices. Both of you are flushed out and he drops the Talisman of Bane. Re-enter to meet the Watcher.

body:
12. Temple gate. Agreeing to join sends you to 13.

2. Entrance from the eye's tear duct. Returning Black Wizards attack.

body:
Map F: Great wound in Moander's arm

title: Map I: Moander's heart
body:
The diagram labels Right Atrium, Left Atrium, Right Ventricle, Left Ventricle, Aorta and Pulmonary Artery.
1. A dying soldier supplies the map and Staff Sling +4.
2. Heavy Cornucopia. Wait for the Watcher's instruction, then collect and deliver it quickly.
3. After event 13, an Iron Golem takes your weapons. Defeat it to recover them, now magnetized. Also obtain Scale Mail +4.
4. Recover the Watcher's Unguent lost at 12 and a Dagger +4.
5. The real Tanetal stimulates muscle with the Talisman of Bane, and LUB immediately flushes you out.
6. Touch wall muscle with weapons magnetized after 3 to reveal Tanetal.
7. Old elven battle wound. Use tools from 8 to retrieve weapons on 4 occasions, two weapons +3 each time. This disturbs sleep and accelerates the heart.
8. Repair tools.
9. Carry the Magic Mouth for LUB and DUB warnings.
10. Final battle with Tanetal.
11. First meeting with the Watcher. Refuse to leave and she explains clearing tissue slime to advance.

13. Deliver the Cornucopia from 2 and help her induce sleep. She gives a Turning Fork and directs you into the Pulmonary Artery for the Unguent.
14. Give her the Unguent. Seeing your magnetized weapons, she sends you to touch Left Ventricle wall muscle.
15. The Watcher sets a trap.
16. Once the trap is ready, find Tanetal here and pursue him to the Right Ventricle for battle.

title: Chapter 21: Mulmaster
body:
The High Imperceptor nominally rules Bane's stronghold of Mulmaster, but Arcam and the Beholders control it behind the scenes. Survive the arena to reach them. This is also the only route through the Cave of the Beholders to the Dark Dimension.
Attacking the swordsmen at the gate raises an alarm, as does disobeying the Banite priests, swordsmen and evil warriors in the guardroom. An alarm before accepting the arena challenge brings massed Beholders. Following the route to the arena is safest.
Win successive battles against Black Dragons, Pyro Snakes, Purple Worms, Salamanders, Ettins, Ogres, Otyughs and Carrion Crawlers. A warrior urges you to compete; the First Justicar first demands a confession, then sends you in.
- Avoid raising the alarm before accepting the challenge.
- Bribe the desk at 14 with 100 platinum to enter the training hall.
- The priests' chant at 15 gives clues to the Beholder maze.

title: Map: Mulmaster
body:
1. Attacking the gate swordsmen immediately raises the alarm.
2. Disobeying Banite priests, swordsmen and evil warriors in the guardroom also triggers it.
3. Mercenary recruiting for Bane.
4. Win the arena's successive battles to enter the Beholder caves; enemies are listed above.
5. A warrior encourages you to compete.
6. The First Justicar demands confession and sends you to the arena. An alarm before accepting the challenge brings many Beholders.
7. Monster pens.
8. A woman warns that Arcam lies ahead.
10. Training hall.
11. Temple of Bane.
14. Bribe the desk with 100 platinum for training.
15. Banite priests chant clues to the Beholder maze.
The map also marks 9,12,13, which the magazine does not explain.

title: Chapter 22: Cave of the Beholders
body:
Arcam guards access to the Dark Dimension. He pretends concern for helpless people still under attack in the Realms, but wants good and evil to exhaust each other so he can seize power. Three magical checkpoints inspect your passage items.
Winning Mulmaster's arena opens stairs down to his lair. Tunnels at 3 and 15 return to the Realms. Eavesdrop along the route to learn that he planned to let you and the planar rulers destroy each other, then take the Realms himself.
His minister, called a ghost king by the magazine, and other monsters confront you while Arcam escapes. Captives ask you to save threatened regions. Deeper areas contain undead halls and lairs, Arcam's antechamber and rooms, and the inspection hall leading to the Dark Phlan portal.
- The three inspectors check for the Horn of Doom, Crystal Ring and Talisman of Bane. The magazine does not state what happens if an item is missing.
- A brave prisoner at 9 reveals the Beholders' plan and gives a silver shield.
- Journal entry 46 gives the route into maze 16.
- At 31, train further if tasks remain in the Realms. Completing more tasks reduces the minister's guards.

title: Map: Beholder hall, 1-9 and 31
body:
Map: Beholder entrance and main hall, 1-9 and 31

9. A brave prisoner explains the Beholders' delaying tactics to strengthen rear defenses and gives a silver shield.
31. The minister's room. Complete outstanding Realms tasks and train further; more completed tasks mean fewer guards.

title: Map: Beholder undead area, 10-14
body:
10. Undead hall.
11. Undead ambush.

title: Map: Exit and maze, 15,16
body: Map: Second exit and maze entrance, 15,16\n15. Second exit to the Realms.\n16. Arcam's maze entrance; directions are in journal entry 46.

title: Map: Arcam's antechamber, 17-20
body:

title: Chapter 23: Dark Phlan
body:
Bane has made another Phlan in the Dark Dimension, ruled by the undead Cadorna. He abducted Sasha and intends to marry her, with Gothmenes officiating. Rescue her before the ceremony ends.
On arrival you fight drow women torturing Sasha, but she is taken away in the confusion. Good weapons can be found here. Bane's monsters gather in the city hall; Cadorna prepares the wedding in the meeting room. Vampires guard the treasure stores.
Do not stand idle at the wedding or Sasha is carried away. Rescuing her grants much experience and two Rings of Protection +2. Drow enchant her dress elsewhere in the wedding area; burn it for experience and search the room for weapons.
- At 7, Gragnak Ulfim explains his betrayal of Sasha.
- Try bluffing past the evil army at 8.
- At 16, following the crowd toward city hall ends in combat whether you attack or try to evade.
- Walking Trees attack in park 15.

title: Chapter 24: Gothmenes' Palace
body:
Blow the Horn of Doom to shatter the iron gate. Inside, Rakshasas pose as Sasha and Elminster. Gothmenes gives you one hour to find the Crystal of Bane, the source of his power.
The crystal lies at the bottom of the Death Pool. Wear the Crystal Ring to dive for it. Use LOOK to find secret doors; much treasure is hidden behind curtains. At the inner sanctuary, a false Elminster reveals Gothmenes' plan to kill the real one. Monsters block you if you try to leave.
In the final battle, Elminster faces the Balor while you fight Gothmenes and his followers.
- At 17, the crystal's bearer can drive off half the followers but loses nearly all hit points.
- After Xoham falls, Gothmenes throws the exhausted Elminster into the Death Pool and offers to teach you the crystal's power. Never repeat Panajuxid: it is a deadly trap.
- Brandish the Talisman of Bane at 6 to repel monsters. Blow the Horn of Doom at 5 to weaken the army's morale.
- Stopping the clock at 15 releases undead. The magazine does not identify the clock.
- Clear all monsters at 7 before resting safely.

title: Conclusion
body: After Gothmenes falls, the Crystal of Bane crumbles to fine sand. Bane's power ends and peace returns to the Realms. The magazine closes with 'The End'.
